subtasks: Pick up the key, hand it over to the other hand, insert it into the keyhole, then turn it.
Pick up the fallen key from the table with the left gripper by its shaft and present its round head for the right hand.
Transfer the elevated key to the right gripper by its exposed round head. Hold the shaft with the left until the right has secured the head.
Recover the key the left hand dropped: pick up its round head from the table with the right hand, point the toothed end downward, and bring it above the lock.
